description: Who is this person in the Canton Dev Fund, by GitHub login: their SIG memberships and organization (from the SIG directory), the proposals they authored, how much they comment and review (and how often they approve or request changes), which proposals asked them to review, which they were assigned, and where a champion line names them. Use to judge who a possible champion or reviewer is and how responsive they are. Canton-specific.
name: get_dev_fund_person
